instructions: Ask the butcher to cut the ribs into pieces of one or two bones, or do it yourself with a heavy knife. Pat them dry and season with 1 tsp of the salt and the pepper.
Chop the onion and bell pepper small. Mince the garlic. Grate the tomatoes on the big holes of a box grater and throw away the skins. That should be about 1 cup.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a wide, deep pan over medium-high heat. Brown the ribs in two batches, about 6 minutes per batch, until they're deep brown on both sides. Transfer them to a plate.
Turn the heat down to medium. Add the onion and bell pepper to the same pan and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and starting to brown.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the smoked paprika for 15 seconds, then add the grated tomato. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until it's thick and darker.
Pour in the broth, add the bay leaf and put the ribs back with any juices on the plate. Bring it to a boil, cover, turn the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat the last tbsp of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the fideos and stir for 3 to 4 minutes, until they're deep golden brown. Watch them closely, they go from toasted to burnt fast.

Stir the toasted fideos and the peas into the pan with the ribs. Add the remaining 1/2 tsp salt. Simmer uncovered for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until the noodles are tender and most of the broth is absorbed.
Take the pan off the heat. Chop 3 tbsp of the parsley and stir it in. Let it rest for 5 minutes.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Serve in shallow bowls with the ribs on top. Store any leftovers in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheat with a splash of water or broth.
method_notes: Okdiario's version leads: ribs and pork browned, a sofrito of onion, pepper and grated tomato, fideos toasted in oil, then broth added to cook the noodles. Monix confirms the sofrito, 1 tbsp pimenton and a rib-and-noodle ratio of roughly 1 part meat to 1 part noodles; here the noodles are cooked in a soupy pan with 5 cups of broth. The sausage (butifarra) is left out and peas come from Monix. Neither page shows a rating, so this is a fallback.
